codeSystems.name: FluidDrainVS
codeSystems.title: Fluid Drain Value Set
codeSystems.description: Valid UCUM units for drain fluid measurement

codeSystems.name: YesNoVS
codeSystems.title: Yes / No Value Set
codeSystems.description: SNOMED CT codes for a simple yes or no answer, used across all home-hospitalization questionnaires.

codeSystems.name: CatheterPatencyVS
codeSystems.title: Catheter Patency Scale
codeSystems.description: SNOMED CT codes representing the ease of blood aspiration or infusion through a vascular catheter, used in OPAT home-hospitalization questionnaires.

codeSystems.name: CatheterTypeVS
codeSystems.title: Catheter Type
codeSystems.description: SNOMED CT codes identifying the type of vascular catheter in place, used in OPAT home-hospitalization questionnaires.

codeSystems.name: ContinenceLevel
codeSystems.title: Continence Level
codeSystems.description: LOINC codes to represent the level of continence reported

codeSystems.name: DecisionVS
codeSystems.title: Medication Administration Decision
codeSystems.description: Codes for the nurse's decision after contraindication assessment — whether to administer, withhold, or take another action following consultation with the hospital care team.

codeSystems.name: HeartFailureSymptoms
codeSystems.title: Heart Failure Symptom Codes
codeSystems.description: SNOMED CT codes representing common patient-reported symptoms in heart failure

codeSystems.name: HolterEventCodes
codeSystems.title: Holter Event Codes
codeSystems.description: Codes used to classify Holter-detected rhythm events

codeSystems.name: HolterEventComponentCodes
codeSystems.title: Holter Observation Component Codes
codeSystems.description: LOINC codes for component observations in Holter events (e.g., heart rate)

codeSystems.name: HomehospSideEffectSeverityVS
codeSystems.title: Home Hospitalization Side Effect Severity Scale
codeSystems.description: SNOMED CT codes representing the severity of side effects in OPAT home-hospitalization questionnaires: Absent, Mild, Moderate and Severe.

codeSystems.name: LumenColorVS
codeSystems.title: Catheter Lumen Color
codeSystems.description: SNOMED CT codes for the color label of a catheter lumen, used in OPAT home-hospitalization questionnaires to distinguish multi-lumen catheters.

codeSystems.name: MedicationStorageVS
codeSystems.title: Medication Storage Status
codeSystems.description: SNOMED CT codes representing whether the home medication storage of a patient is appropriate or has issues, used in OPAT and ONCO home-hospitalization questionnaires.

codeSystems.name: NormalAbnormalVS
codeSystems.title: Normal / Abnormal Finding
codeSystems.description: SNOMED CT codes to represent a binary normal vs. abnormal clinical finding, used for dressing, insertion-site, and catheter observation items in OPAT home-hospitalization questionnaires.

codeSystems.name: ONCOSymptomGradeVS
codeSystems.title: ONCO Symptom Grade Scale (CTCAE 0–3)
codeSystems.description: SNOMED CT codes representing the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) grade scale 0 to 3, used to score symptom severity in ONCO home-hospitalization questionnaires.

codeSystems.name: PainScale
codeSystems.title: Pain severity - 0-10 verbal numeric rating
codeSystems.description: Pain severity scale, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst pain imaginable. See https://loinc.org/72514-3

codeSystems.name: SymptomSeverity
codeSystems.title: Symptom Severity Scale
codeSystems.description: SNOMED CT codes to represent severity of patient-reported symptoms

codeSystems.name: TrueFalseVS
codeSystems.title: True / False Value Set
codeSystems.description: SNOMED CT codes for a simple true or false answer.

codeSystems.name: WellPoorScale
codeSystems.title: 0-10 scale, 0.5 increments, Very well to Very poor
codeSystems.description: Scale going from 0 to 10 in increments of 0.5. Indicating values very well to very port (see https://loinc.org/LL3092-5)
